entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane formed of five collided shards.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who uses beings on the five shards as secret eyes and ears and put Alaran obelisks to use in Alara Unbroken.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara home to rhoxes and a caste system.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara where etherium perfects the flaws of organic life.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A death-choked shard of Alara scavenged by the kathari.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara home to dragons.

entities.name: Kathari
entities.description: A race of buzzard-like bird humanoids that scavenge Grixis.

entities.name: Rhoxes
entities.description: A proud, reverent race of burly rhino-humanoids of Bant.

relations.note: They scavenge the realms of Grixis.
relations.quote: that scavenge the death-choked realms of Grixis
